_README: Write the story behind a photo here. Add one line per file: the key is the exact filename as it appears in this folder, and the value is the text shown to the right of the photo. Ajs Headshot.JPG: I decided to take my own headshots for my LinkedIn, email, and anywhere else I needed a headshot. I'd like to think I took it myself because I didn't want to pay for a professional headshot, but really it was because I had a little Dunning-Krueger effect going on... nonetheless I think it worked out well.
Base of Gobblers Knob.JPG: This is a photo of myself and a friends boots at the base of Gobblers Knob. Gobblers Knob is a trail that leads to a fire lookout tower w/ a view of Mt Ranier.
